summary: BI-640B011D + BI-873F3C48 (Simplify & Strengthen W2/W3, architecture pass 2026-08-16 §3.2). Structural integrity + lifecycle coverage only — NO new data columns, NO row mutations, NO backfill. W2: (1) 29 justified FK-leading indexes (each migration statement cites its query path; misses are budgeted by scripts/check-fk-index-coverage.mjs, not mechanically indexed); (2) 7 real FK relations for Workroom's bare link columns (featureBuildId, taskRunId, gitPromotionCandidateId, changePromotionId, leaseHolderPrincipalId, createdByPrincipalId, requestedByPrincipalId) added NOT VALID with ON DELETE SET NULL so legacy orphan values never wedge the forward-only chain; backlogItemId/epicId deliberately excluded (mixed live key shapes); (3) NOT VALID organizationId FKs on 20 models (Staffing* family among them). W3: 21 append-only growth tables enrolled in PURGE_POLICIES (with 2 new categories integration-log/edge-telemetry), 2 Care* status-event tables added to RETAINED_DATASETS (HIPAA-adjacent), 4 growth-shaped business-record models deliberately allowlisted, and 17 leading time-column indexes so the sweep never seq-scans (migrations 20260816100000 + 20260816101000). New CI ratchets: check-fk-index-coverage.mjs and check-retention-enrollment.mjs with owned baselines (owner platform-architecture, expiry 2026-11-16).
